diffs.diff: distance_mm: datasheet reading gives 1 per count, the part's model has none
diffs.evidence: The model does encode 1 mm per count: sim.uartReplies (the uart-device reply table, src/core/customParts.ts line 57) answers 0x55 with a 16-bit value, scale 1, and the driver returns (d[0] << 8) | d[1] in mm. The gate's authorConversions() only reads sim.measure/measures/responses, not uartReplies, so it reports 'none'. Datasheet: 'In UART mode, send 0x55 and read back two bytes (16 bit value) that is mm distance'. Adafruit driver: 'dist = (data[1] + (data[0] << 8)) / 10' (cm, i.e. 1 mm per count).

diffs.diff: temperature_C: datasheet reading gives 1 per count, the part's model has none
diffs.evidence: The model encodes 1 degC per count with offset -45: sim.uartReplies answers 0x50 with an 8-bit value, scale 1, offset -45, and the driver returns d[0] - 45, matching the second reading (scale 1, offset -45). The gate does not read uartReplies, hence 'none'. Adafruit CircuitPython US-100 driver: writes bytes([0x50]), reads 1 byte, 'temp = data[0] - 45'.
